title: Picard affine structure projective representation
statement: Let f:X→S be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation; let M be an X-module, k:W→S, and U an affine open of W such that the tensor pullback of M to X×S U is isomorphic to its structure sheaf. With R=Gamma(W,U), the restriction to the localized U-site of R(pullback.snd f k)_*((pullback.fst f k)^*M[0]) is isomorphic to Q of the termwise affinePerfectSheafification W U hU of some bounded complex P of finite projective R-modules. Use the supplied derived categories on all schemes and localized open sites. No universal structure-unit or homology hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Put R=Gamma(W,U), j=isoSpec.inv followed by U.ι, Y=X times S Spec R, and p=X times S W -> W. Construct q:Y -> X times S W by the pullback universal property. Cancellation of the outer pullback squares proves IsPullback q r p j; hence q is an open immersion. The exact functor H from W-modules to Spec R-modules, obtained by restriction to U followed by inverse affine-site transport, is naturally ordinary restriction along j. The proved sectionwise square Modules.pushforwardRestrictIso, from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.RestrictPushforward, identifies p_* H with restriction along q followed by r_*. Derive this square using exactness of H, K-injective preservation of q-restriction, and the right-derived composition comparisons. Tensor pullback composition and the unit pullback isomorphism transport the given coefficient trivialization to Y. Commutation of exact derived functors with the single functor then identifies the displayed localized image with affine-site transport of Rr_* O_Y[0]. The transport equivalence counit cancels H followed by forward transport.

The base-changed r is proper, flat and locally of finite presentation. Its structure sheaf is invertible, hence finitely presented and relatively flat. Apply properFlat_single_derivedDirectImage_perfect to r and O_Y, the perfectness-only specialization of Tag 0B91(2). Perfectness supplies quasi-coherent cohomology. Apply perfect_iff_affine_bounded_projective to the resulting object on Spec R to obtain a bounded complex P of finite projective R-modules and its representing isomorphism.

Map the representing isomorphism through the explicit exact affine-site equivalence. Its mapDerivedCategoryFactors comparison and mapHomologicalComplexCompIso identify the image with Q of affinePerfectSheafification W U hU applied termwise to P. Compose with the open comparison from the first step. Retain exactly the bounds, finiteness and projectivity witnesses furnished in the second step. All the maps and constructions exist for empty U and the zero ring as well.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_affine_structure_projective_representation
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (M : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (htrivial : Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf)) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} (W.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (P.X n)) ∧
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
        (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((affinePerfectSheafification W U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
